title: The Old Training Field
text: Rusted training machines sit in the long grass, and a punching post worn smooth by generations of Machop. Someone kept this place, once.

choices.label: Drill against the post
choices.hint: Upgrade a random move. Lose 5 HP.

title: The Steaming Spring
text: A hot spring bubbles up between the rocks, too hot to sit in for long. Something metal glints under the surface, further down than you would like.

choices.label: Reach for it
choices.hint: Lose 9 HP. Obtain a held item.

title: The Move Tutor
text: An old trainer sits cross-legged in the shade with a notebook on his knee. He has taught this route's Pokemon for forty years, and he is not busy.

choices.label: Let him study you
choices.hint: Forget a random move. Gain 20 gold.

title: The Berry Tree
text: A Sitrus tree leans over the path, heavy and unpicked. A Pidgey watches you from the branches, entirely unbothered.

title: The Grunt in the Path
text: A man in black stands square across the trail with his arms folded. There is a stolen Poke Ball on his belt and no intention of moving.

choices.label: Pay
choices.hint: Lose 60 gold. Obtain a held item.

title: The Roadside Stall
text: Berries in baskets, a handwritten price list, and a tin for coins. The owner is nowhere in sight. A Munchlax dozes beside the tin, one paw on a coin pouch.

choices.label: Pay the asking price
choices.hint: Lose 40 gold. Obtain an item and heal 8 HP.

choices.label: Walk on by
choices.hint: Gain 25 gold. The Munchlax pushes the pouch after you.

title: The Hiker's Pack
text: A hiker sets his pack down and lays TMs out on a flat rock, one at a time, like he has all day. He probably does.

choices.label: Buy the TM
choices.hint: Lose 30 gold. Add Howl to your deck.

title: Nightfall on the Route
text: The light is going. There is a flat patch of grass here, out of the wind, and nobody would blame you for stopping. The next stretch will keep until morning.

choices.label: Train through the night
choices.hint: Upgrade a random move. Lose 8 HP.

title: The Old Workings
text: A cut in the hillside, propped with beams that have gone soft, and a spoil heap the rain has been sorting for fifty years. Someone has been back recently. There is a flat stone with three things laid out on it, squared up, and nobody anywhere to ask.

choices.label: Take the TM and work the heap yourself
choices.hint: Add Rock Slide to your deck. Lose 10 HP.

choices.label: Leave the stone as you found it
